WITH changes AS (
    SELECT
        ph."UserId",
        ph."CreationDate",
        ph."UserDisplayName" AS new_name,
        LAG(ph."UserDisplayName") OVER (PARTITION BY ph."UserId" ORDER BY ph."CreationDate") AS prev_name,
        LAG(ph."CreationDate") OVER (PARTITION BY ph."UserId" ORDER BY ph."CreationDate") AS prev_date
    FROM "postHistory" ph
    WHERE ph."UserId" IS NOT NULL
      AND ph."UserDisplayName" IS NOT NULL
),
name_changes AS (
    SELECT
        "UserId",
        "CreationDate",
        prev_name,
        new_name,
        (julianday("CreationDate") - julianday(prev_date)) AS interval_days,
        strftime('%Y-%m', "CreationDate") AS month
    FROM changes
    WHERE prev_name IS NOT NULL                -- there is a previous record
      AND prev_name <> new_name                -- the display name actually changed
      AND strftime('%Y', "CreationDate") = '2020'
),
month_stats AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT "UserId") AS distinct_user_cnt,
        AVG(interval_days) AS avg_interval_days
    FROM name_changes
    GROUP BY month
),
top_months AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM month_stats
    ORDER BY avg_interval_days DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
    nc."UserId",
    nc.prev_name AS previous_display_name,
    nc.new_name AS new_display_name,
    nc."CreationDate" AS change_date,
    ms.distinct_user_cnt,
    ms.avg_interval_days
FROM name_changes nc
JOIN month_stats ms ON nc.month = ms.month
WHERE nc.month IN (SELECT month FROM top_months)
ORDER BY ms.avg_interval_days DESC, nc.month, nc."UserId";

-- Note: This schema does not have a table tracking display name changes. Using postHistory UserDisplayName as proxy.
WITH name_history AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        UserDisplayName AS DisplayName,
        CreationDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserId ORDER BY CreationDate) AS rn
    FROM postHistory
    WHERE UserDisplayName IS NOT NULL 
      AND strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2020'
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        h1.UserId,
        h1.DisplayName AS PrevDisplayName,
        h2.DisplayName AS NewDisplayName,
        h2.CreationDate AS ChangeDate,
        julianday(h2.CreationDate) - julianday(h1.CreationDate) AS DaysBetween
    FROM name_history h1
    INNER JOIN name_history h2 ON h1.UserId = h2.UserId AND h2.rn = h1.rn + 1
    WHERE h1.DisplayName != h2.DisplayName
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', ChangeDate) AS CalendarMonth,
        COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS DistinctUserCount
    FROM consecutive_pairs
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', ChangeDate)
),
avg_intervals_per_month AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', ChangeDate) AS CalendarMonth,
        AVG(DaysBetween) AS AvgDaysBetweenConsecutiveChanges
    FROM consecutive_pairs
    WHERE DaysBetween IS NOT NULL AND DaysBetween > 0
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', ChangeDate)
),
top_three_months AS (
    SELECT CalendarMonth
    FROM avg_intervals_per_month
    ORDER BY AvgDaysBetweenConsecutiveChanges DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
full_change_details AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        PrevDisplayName,
        NewDisplayName,
        ChangeDate
    FROM consecutive_pairs
)
SELECT CalendarMonth, DistinctUserCount, AvgDaysBetweenConsecutiveChanges
FROM monthly_changes m
JOIN avg_intervals_per_month a ON m.CalendarMonth = a.CalendarMonth
ORDER BY m.CalendarMonth;

-- Additional query for top 3 months:
-- SELECT CalendarMonth FROM top_three_months ORDER BY (SELECT AVG(DaysBetween) FROM consecutive_pairs c WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', c.ChangeDate) = top_three_months.CalendarMonth) DESC;

-- Full details per change:
-- SELECT UserId, PrevDisplayName, NewDisplayName, ChangeDate FROM full_change_details;

GROUP BY u.Id;

SELECT u.DisplayName,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.Name) AS ModerationPowers
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE LOWER(b.Name) = 'moderator'
GROUP BY u.DisplayName;

SELECT u.DisplayName, b.Name AS ModerationPower
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE LOWER(b.Name) LIKE '%moderator%' OR LOWER(b.Name) LIKE '%diamond%' OR LOWER(b.Name) LIKE '%staff%' OR LOWER(b.Name) LIKE '%admin%'

SELECT "u"."DisplayName", GROUP_CONCAT("b"."Name") AS "moderation_powers" FROM "users" AS "u" JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "u"."Id" = "b"."UserId" WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "badges" AS "b2" WHERE "b2"."UserId" = "u"."Id" AND "b2"."Name" = 'Moderator') GROUP BY "u"."Id", "u"."DisplayName";

-- Note: The provided schema does not contain IP address tracking tables or columns.
-- The following query assumes a user_logins table exists with UserId, IP, and LoginDate columns.

SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    lt.most_recent_ip,
    lt.ip_count
FROM users u
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        COUNT(DISTINCT IP) AS ip_count,
        LAST_VALUE(IP) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY LoginDate DESC) AS most_recent_ip
    FROM user_logins
    GROUP BY UserId
) lt ON u.Id = lt.UserId
ORDER BY lt.ip_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

       NULL AS most_recent_ip,
       0 AS distinct_ip_count
FROM users u
WHERE 1 = 0
ORDER BY distinct_ip_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

votes.sql:
SELECT u.WebsiteUrl
FROM users u
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS post_count
    FROM posts p
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
) p ON u.Id = p.user_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p2.OwnerUserId AS answerer_id, COUNT(*) AS accepted_answer_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN posts p2 ON p.AcceptedAnswerId = p2.Id
    GROUP BY p2.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) a ON u.Id = a.answerer_id

WITH post_counts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId, COUNT(*) AS post_cnt
    FROM posts
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
),
accepted_counts AS (
    SELECT a.OwnerUserId, COUNT(DISTINCT a.Id) AS accepted_cnt
    FROM posts a
    JOIN posts q ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id
    WHERE a.PostTypeId = 2
    GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT
    NULL AS Email,
    NULL AS Phone,
    u.WebsiteUrl AS LinkedInProfile
FROM users u
JOIN post_counts pc ON pc.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN accepted_counts ac ON ac.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE pc.post_cnt >= 50 AND ac.accepted_cnt >= 3;

votes.sql:
WITH monthly_user_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', CreationDate) AS month,
        Location AS referral_source,
        COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM users
    WHERE CreationDate >= DATE('now', '-1 year')
    GROUP BY month, referral_source
),
ranked_sources AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        referral_source,
        user_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY user_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM monthly_user_counts
)
SELECT 
    month,
    referral_source,
    user_count
FROM ranked_sources
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY month, rank;

WITH user_src AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', CreationDate) AS month,
        CASE
            WHEN WebsiteUrl IS NULL THEN 'Direct'
            WHEN LOWER(WebsiteUrl) LIKE '%google%' THEN 'Google'
            WHEN LOWER(WebsiteUrl) LIKE '%twitter%' THEN 'Twitter'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS source
    FROM users
    WHERE CreationDate >= date((SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM users), '-1 year')
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT month, source, COUNT(*) AS user_count
    FROM user_src
    GROUP BY month, source
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month, source, user_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY user_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, source, user_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY month, rn;

WITH user_spans AS (
    SELECT u.Id,
           u.Location,
           MIN(p.CreaionDate) AS first_date,
           MAX(p.CreaionDate) AS last_date,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(p.CreaionDate)) - JULIANDAY(MIN(p.CreaionDate)) AS span_days
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.Location
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY span_days DESC) AS rn
    FROM user_spans
)
SELECT Id AS UserId,
       NULL AS Email,
       NULL AS MobilePhone
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY Location, span_days DESC;

WITH UserPostSpans AS (
    SELECT 
        u.Id AS UserId,
        u.Location,
        u.DisplayName,
        MIN(p.CreaionDate) AS FirstPostDate,
        MAX(p.CreaionDate) AS LastPostDate,
        CAST(julianday(MAX(p.CreaionDate)) - julianday(MIN(p.CreaionDate)) AS INTEGER) AS TimeSpanInDays
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
    WHERE u.Location IS NOT NULL AND u.Location != ''
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.Location, u.DisplayName
),
Top3ByLocation AS (
    SELECT 
        Location,
        DisplayName,
        TimeSpanInDays,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY TimeSpanInDays DESC) AS RankInLocation
    FROM UserPostSpans
)
SELECT 
    Location,
    DisplayName,
    TimeSpanInDays
FROM Top3ByLocation
WHERE RankInLocation <= 3
ORDER BY Location, RankInLocation;

WITH user_span AS (
    SELECT
        u.Location,
        u.Id AS user_id,
        MIN(p.CreaionDate) AS first_post,
        MAX(p.CreaionDate) AS last_post
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.Location
),
span_calc AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        user_id,
        (julianday(last_post) - julianday(first_post)) AS time_span_days
    FROM user_span
)
SELECT
    Location,
    NULL AS email,
    NULL AS mobile_phone
FROM (
    SELECT
        Location,
        user_id,
        time_span_days,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY time_span_days DESC) AS rn
    FROM span_calc
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY Location, rn;

votes.sql:
SELECT u.Location,
       AVG(u.Reputation) AS average_salary,
       COUNT(b.Id) AS total_badges
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges tb WHERE tb.UserId = u.Id AND tb.Name = 'Teacher')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId = u.Id AND c.Score > 50)
GROUP BY u.Location;

SELECT u.Location, AVG(u.Reputation) AS average_salary, COUNT(DISTINCT b.Id) AS total_badges FROM users u INNER JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId INNER JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId WHERE b.Name = 'Teacher' AND c.Score > 50 GROUP BY u.Location

WITH qualified_users AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.Location, u.Reputation
    FROM users u
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId = u.Id AND c.Score > 50
    )
)
SELECT
    qu.Location,
    AVG(qu.Reputation) AS average_salary,
    COUNT(b.Id) AS total_badges
FROM qualified_users qu
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = qu.Id
GROUP BY qu.Location;

votes.sql:
WITH engagement AS (
    SELECT c."UserId" AS UserId,
           ou."Location" AS Location,
           (julianday(c."CreationDate") - julianday(p."CreationDate")) * 24 * 60.0 AS SessionMinutes,
           CAST(strftime('%H', c."CreationDate") AS INTEGER) AS CommentHour
    FROM "comments" c
    JOIN "posts" p ON c."PostId" = p."Id"
    JOIN "users" ou ON p."OwnerUserId" = ou."Id"
    WHERE ou."Location" IS NOT NULL
),
avg_dur AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           Location,
           AVG(SessionMinutes) AS AvgSessionMinutes
    FROM engagement
    GROUP BY UserId, Location
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5   -- optional threshold for "regularly" engage
),
hour_counts AS (
    SELECT UserId,
           Location,
           CommentHour,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM engagement
    GROUP BY UserId, Location, CommentHour
),
most_hour AS (
    SELECT hc.UserId,
           hc.Location,
           hc.CommentHour AS MostActiveHour
    FROM hour_counts hc
    JOIN (
        SELECT UserId, Location, MAX(cnt) AS maxcnt
        FROM hour_counts
        GROUP BY UserId, Location
    ) mx ON hc.UserId = mx.UserId
         AND hc.Location = mx.Location
         AND hc.cnt = mx.maxcnt
)
SELECT a.UserId,
       a.Location,
       a.AvgSessionMinutes,
       m.MostActiveHour
FROM avg_dur a
JOIN most_hour m ON a.UserId = m.UserId AND a.Location = m.Location;

}WITH user_engagement AS (
    SELECT 
        u.Id AS UserId,
        u.Location,
        u.DisplayName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) AS comment_count
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.Id = c.UserId
    WHERE u.Location IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.Location, u.DisplayName
    HAVING post_count + comment_count > 0
),
location_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        ue.UserId,
        ue.Location,
        ue.DisplayName,
        ue.post_count,
        ue.comment_count,
        CAST(AVG(CAST(strftime('%H', p.CreationDate) AS INTEGER))) AS avg_hour,
        CAST(MAX(CAST(strftime('%H', p.CreationDate) AS INTEGER))) AS most_active_hour
    FROM user_engagement ue
    LEFT JOIN posts p ON ue.UserId = p.OwnerUserId
    WHERE p.CreationDate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ue.UserId, ue.Location, ue.DisplayName, ue.post_count, ue.comment_count
)
SELECT 
    la.Location,
    la.DisplayName,
    ROUND(la.avg_hour, 2) AS avg_session_duration,
    la.most_active_hour
FROM location_activity la
WHERE la.post_count + la.comment_count > 1
ORDER BY la.Location, la.DisplayName

WITH user_post AS (
    SELECT u.Id AS user_id,
           u.DisplayName AS user_name,
           u.Location AS location,
           p.Id AS post_id,
           p."CreaionDate" AS post_creation,
           p."LasActivityDate" AS post_last_activity
    FROM "users" u
    JOIN "posts" p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location IS NOT NULL
      AND p."CreaionDate" IS NOT NULL
      AND p."LasActivityDate" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT up.user_name,
       up.location,
       AVG((julianday(up.post_last_activity) - julianday(up.post_creation)) * 24 * 60) AS avg_session_duration_minutes,
       (SELECT strftime('%H', up2.post_creation)
        FROM user_post up2
        WHERE up2.user_id = up.user_id
          AND up2.location = up.location
        GROUP BY strftime('%H', up2.post_creation)
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS most_active_posting_hour
FROM user_post up
GROUP BY up.user_id, up.location
HAVING COUNT(up.post_id) > 1;
